question: In which of the following Indian states does the southwest monsoon set first to give rainfall?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Southwest Monsoon** is a seasonal wind pattern that brings heavy rainfall to the Indian subcontinent during the summer months.
 
• It typically begins its onset in the **coastal state of Kerala**, located along the southwestern coast of India.
